name: FP8 block-scales routed-experts patch
canonical_description: Patch required to keep routed MoE expert execution on the intended FP8 block-scales path.
mechanism: Adds the missing FP8_BLOCK_SCALES routed-experts branch to vLLM's ModelOpt mixed-precision dispatch so 128x128 block-scaled FP8 MTP routed experts are routed to Fp8MoEMethod with the checkpoint's group_size/block-size metadata.
constraints: Upstream vLLM lacks the FP8_BLOCK_SCALES branch at the recorded commit and current main; upgrading alone does not enable MTP for this checkpoint.
The patch reads the block size from the checkpoint metadata rather than guessing, because a wrong block shape can apply misaligned scales silently.
The recorded MiaAI-Lab lane applies the patch through start.sh/bind-mount at runtime; it is not an image rebuild.
tradeoffs: Without the patch, the MoE can load unquantized and fail roughly seven minutes into load with a missing w2_weight_scale_inv parameter.
This packet records a runtime-correctness mechanism; it does not by itself establish a speed, fit, or quality effect.
re_review_triggers: Upstream vLLM adds an FP8_BLOCK_SCALES routed-experts branch.
The checkpoint's MTP routed-expert quantization metadata changes.
A setup claims the patch caused a performance or quality effect without a matching comparison object.

canonical_sources.locator: FP8_BLOCK_SCALES routed experts checkpoint-patch section and the upstream-gap note
canonical_sources.note: Builder README recording the missing vLLM dispatch branch, the failure mode, and the runtime patch behavior.

note: Canonical technique identity only. A setup-specific claim must still carry its own statement, source, locator, lineage, evidence level, and contrast kind.
